Hi Samir — great, Wed 14:00 PT is scheduled on our side. Calendar invite with dial-in to follow.

Proposed call agenda (to confirm during the intro):
- 0–5 min: Introductions + roles (HelioQuest / Redwood)
- 5–25 min: CAIQ/SIG scoping — which modules are in scope and any gaps you’ve already documented
- 25–40 min: Evidence request deep dive: we’ll list exactly what we need and why (examples below)
- 40–45 min: Next steps, owners, dates

Evidence we typically request during intake (please bring samples where possible):
- Architecture diagram (network boundaries, VPCs, subnets)
- Sample access logs (nginx/ELB) covering a short 24–72 hour window
- Inference audit logs (token-level or request-level, redacted if needed)
- Auth logs / SSO assertions (example: SAML/Okta events for a sample user)
- Short list of retention policies and where backups live

KMS/HSM: we support customers using external KMS (Vault, AWS KMS) and HSM-backed keys. If you can share which KMS type you use (Vault version + deployment model), it’ll help us map the CAIQ encryption questions.

Action items before the call:
- Samir: share any current CAIQ/CAIQ-extract and identify a primary compliance contact (due Tue 09/22)
- Marissa: attach Redwood’s SIG/CAIQ template and an evidence action tracker (done)
- Rishi: prepare a short checklist of sample logs we’ll request and a safe-redaction guide (due Tue 09/22)

I’m attaching our SIG action template to make the handoff easier.

Thanks — Kim
